realModel.narrative: The investigation of synthetic USD SKU SYN-10-PREMIUM across the authorized companies has revealed the following. Two orders were identified, each with a recognized revenue and production cost basis. The contribution margin for each order is estimated and not verified as net profit. The total contribution margin is USD 83.50, derived from the combined contributions of the two orders. The contribution margin for the first order is USD 30.50, and for the second order, it is USD 53.00. Both contributions are based on estimated costs and margins, with no verified net profit claims. The costs and margins are estimated, and unknown values are not treated as zero. The sources of the contribution margins are explicitly recorded and recognized. The findings are subject to the assumptions that revenue recognizes completed merchandise quantities after source line discounts, total refunds may include tax/shipping and are not allocated to products, and catalog production and shipping quotes remain estimates. The contribution margins are not verified as net profit, and pre-fee gross margins are omitted. The calculation is conditional and requires human review of supplier quotes, product equivalence, fee evidence, and pricing. No business action has been executed, and the findings await human review.

unsuccessfulRuns.narrative: The analysis of the commerce records across companies reveals that the contribution margins for the orders are estimated due to missing transaction and channel fees. The contribution margins are as follows: Order 203 and Order 3 each have a contribution margin of USD 14.00, Order 4 has a contribution margin of USD 30.00, and Order 910003 has a contribution margin of USD 30.50. These margins are based on the recognized revenue and estimated costs, with the costs excluding transaction and channel fees.

review.reason: Model mislabeled pre-fee gross margins as contribution for three source orders whose transaction/channel fees and full contribution were UNKNOWN. No finding was published.

unsuccessfulRuns.narrative: The investigation of the synthetic USD SKU SYN-10-PREMIUM across the authorized companies has revealed the following details. Two orders were identified, each with a recognized revenue and production cost basis. The contribution margin for each order is estimated, and the total contribution margin is also estimated. The financial rule indicates that the contribution is not a complete number due to missing fees or partial recognition, and pre-fee gross margins are deliberately omitted. The costs and margins are estimated, and unknown values are not treated as zero.

review.reason: Actual source components are complete estimates, but the narrative wrongly interprets a conditional financial rule as missing selected fees/recognition and omits the calculated amounts. No finding published.
